name: The Lost Lightbearer
notes: L11-B1 (drafts/planning/L11-SPEC.md section 3): belt 10 Guardian, built only from Hearth Cook parts (two counterable circles, one dash-only lane, two helpers at two-thirds health). Base 495/17/30 like the Floor Keeper. Name, intro, freed and lore come from drafts/content/bosses/lost-lightbearer.json and bestiary-plan.json. PLACEHOLDER: the phase tells, sensei lines, attack note, tip and description wait for L11-C2.

phases.tell: A striped lane and double marks.

lines.intro: Someone is up here, holding the last light.
lines.freed: You came all this way to help? Now we can finish together.
lines.senseiAfter: Love brought the light home, and it brought them home too.
freedScene: The storm clouds thin and drift away.
The traveler looks up, still holding the last piece.
"You came all this way to help? Now we can finish together."
Together, you lift the piece onto the empty stand.
The Great Lamp shines over the whole town again.

description: The Lost Lightbearer makes red circles, calls spark sprites, then sends a striped lane.

bestiary.tip: Counter the circles. Dash the stripes.

lore.black: The traveler, wrapped in storm clouds. They are tired from holding the last piece. Free them, and the light comes home.
